item.title: Linked List
item.description: Here I am 👋, it’s been 5 months or so since i wrote my first blog and this is my second. Yeah that’s my level of productivity 😶‍🌫️. item.title: Hello World
item.description: This is my first blog . I’m in my college first year and watched The Social Network and got the idea of starting a blog this was also inspired by my college seniors , so here I am .I’m starting this blog in a retrospective way so that I know how clueless I’m in my early days .
